dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with serrated perimeters; prominent gradient transition from dark exterior to high-intensity thin circular boundaries surrounding dark internal cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of scattered, small, light-colored pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, most visible in the anterior and dorsal regions where the ring pattern is less defined.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent Macro-Annuli in the mid-dorsal region form a scalene triangle; a dense cluster of smaller annuli and blobs on the upper lateral flank forms a complex polygonal network.
